headline: HuyenBao v11.27 — SQLite tự host trên VPS (chat/bạn bè/quà/BXH thật, không cần Supabase) + Admin dashboard + nền đổi màu theo sức khoẻ
summary: SELF-HOSTED SQLITE + ADMIN. The community backend now runs ON YOUR OWN VPS with zero extra services: /api/social/* route handlers persist chat, friends, gifts, presence and the leaderboard into a local SQLite file (data/social.db, WAL mode, all input clamped server-side, gifts restricted to accepted friends, 1.2s server flood guard). The browser auto-detects the backend with one /api/social/ping probe — Supabase env vars are no longer needed, and the supabase-js npm dependency is GONE (loaded from CDN only when Supabase is explicitly configured), which permanently fixes the VPS build error "Module not found: Can't resolve '@supabase/supabase-js'". Backends: supabase (env) > sqlite (server detected) > demo (static hosts). New /admin dashboard (key-guarded by the ADMIN_KEY env var) shows players, online, messages/gifts 24h, friendships, DB size and the top-10 board. UI: the whole app is tinted by health state (5 transparent levels from emerald 'best' to pulsing red 'danger'), the Overview tab opens with a needs-attention strip (cash / net worth / income per year / health — colour-coded, plus a warning line for critical health, short sleep, no diet, debt, negative income), the what's-new popup carries EN/VI/ZH buttons, the market gets a portfolio card (total holdings + today's movers) and one-tap MAX buy / ALL sell, and the nav menu is now 3D (perspective tilt + press depth). 6 new integration tests cover the SQLite layer (identity codes, clamps, flood guard, friends flow, gift claim-once, admin stats).
features: SQLITE BACKEND: /api/social/{ping,init,messages,friends,gifts,presence,leaderboard} on better-sqlite3 — data/social.db (WAL), auto-created schema
ZERO-CONFIG VPS: browser probes /api/social/ping once and upgrades demo → sqlite automatically; NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCIAL_BACKEND=sqlite forces it
BUILD FIX: @supabase/supabase-js removed from dependencies — loaded from CDN only when Supabase env vars are set; VPS builds no longer fail on missing node_modules
SERVER RULES: all strings clamped, uid validated, gifts only between accepted friends, 1.2s flood guard, unique read-aloud HB- codes
ADMIN DASHBOARD: /admin protected by ADMIN_KEY env var — players, online (13s window), messages/gifts 24h, friendships, DB size, top 10
HEALTH TINT: whole-app transparent background wash in 5 levels (life-0 best … life-4 danger with slow pulse), driven by healthState()
ATTENTION STRIP: Overview opens with cash / net worth / income-per-year / health cards + aggregated warnings (critical health, sleep <7h, no diet, debt, negative income)
MARKET: portfolio card with total holdings + today's best/worst movers; one-tap MAX buy and ALL sell per stock
POPUP i18n: language buttons (EN/VI/ZH) inside the what's-new modal
3D NAV: group + sub-tab buttons tilt in perspective, lift on hover, press down on click (respects prefers-reduced-motion)
TESTS: 6 integration tests for the SQLite layer; 141 tests total
Version bumped to v11.27 at FRONT of app name
